note: Existing geometry-audit offenders (src/canalRecall/landmarks/geometryAudit.ts). audit:glb fails a model only when a gated count (opening-floating-fail, opening-overhang-fail, zfight-m2, and since 2026-10-11 window-rhythm-fail / window-mismatch-spec / window-missing-spec on photo-spec facades) grows past its entry. Lower an entry when you fix a model; never raise one to pass. The window-rhythm keys were recorded for every model with an <id>-elevations.json on 2026-10-11 (lane fix/american-hotel-windows-20261011); american-hotel has no allowance (0 failing facades). The zfight keys were re-recorded for every landmark on 2026-10-13 (lane zfight-audit): zfight-m2 is now same-facing overlap under 2 cm (2.5 deg normal tolerance, measured against the larger triangle's plane), zfight-tight-m2 is 2-3 cm (gated like zfight-m2), zfight-near-m2 (2-8 cm) and zfight-same-m2 (a material against itself) are recorded for information only. opening-outside-parts / opening-outside-m2 (openingsWithinWalls, hard since 2026-10-16, lane homomonument-krijtberg) recorded for every recorded model on 2026-10-16; a recorded model may not add a part past its wall nor grow the area by more than 0.02 m2, a new export must have none.
